status: Research experiment only; no release authorization
hypothesis: When verified county/district geography is absent, treat the real race total as one named race-level reporting unit, with its frozen candidate mean and uncertainty. Evaluate instead of inventing geography or declaring county completion.
representation: One race-level unit with actual D/R/total votes and the source race reporting estimate. Prior is the same independently captured pre-election candidate forecast. No fabricated county IDs.
training: Unchanged 2020 count likelihood and independently dated pre-election anchor. No fit on evaluation outcomes.
selection: Every existing accepted 2022 House and state frame with positive race count and source reporting at least 25%; keep all exclusions and report competitive races separately
honesty: These evaluation races have already been inspected during other experiments. This is exploratory model-selection evidence; do not describe it as a newly untouched cohort.
report: All races, prior-competitive races and previously inspected split
publication: Research only until adequate independent confirmation and full candidate/rule semantics are established.
